```plato

    // A face's orientation-free identity: its three corner indices in ascending
    // order, so the two windings of a shared interior face match.
    SortedFaceKey(face: TriangleFace): IntegerVector3 {
        var a = face.A.Value;
        var b = face.B.Value;
        var c = face.C.Value;
        var lowest = a.Min(b).Min(c);
        var highest = a.Max(b).Max(c);
        return (lowest, a + b + c - lowest - highest, highest);
    }
```
